sentences: First a[0] and a[1] become 6 at the same time, then a[2] takes a[0], so a[0] stays 6, giving 6, 7, 5.
At the start a[0] and a[1] are copied together, so a[0] becomes 6 and holds it, then a[1] and a[2] shift.
Looking at line one, a[0] gets a[1] while a[1] keeps its value, so both are 6, then a[2] gets 6.
Since a[0] becomes 6 at the same moment a[1] is copied, after the second line a[0] is still 6 and a[1] is 7.
The first assignment sets a[0] to 6 alongside a[1], then a[2] is set from that 6, leaving the list as 6, 7, 5.
